mapper.select: SELECT * FROM chat_session ORDER BY updated_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_session (id, kb_id, title, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{kbId}, #{title}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_session SET kb_id=#{kbId}, title=#{title}, updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE id=#{id}
